name: Falling Debris: Voxel Demolition
summary:
A whole city made of cubes, ready to come down your way.

You work for Kimo Demolitions: you've been hired to take the city down, block by block. Houses, towers and glass facades are thousands of cubes, and everything breaks. Take out the base of a building and watch it fall.

REAL COLLAPSES
- Whatever loses its support breaks away and falls in real pieces.
- Whatever gets crushed breaks into loose cubes that bounce all over the place.
- Dust, a deep rumble and controller vibration with every collapse.

SEV
